name: Vaillancourt Fountain
note: Embarcadero (Justin Herman) Plaza, brutalist square-tube concrete tangle over a basin. POSITION CORRECTED 2026-09-23: was 37.7946/-122.3946, which is 111 m south-east of the real thing and outside the plaza (owner). Now the centre of way/27146056, the fountain's own concrete area in OSM (x 1445.8..1484.8, z 256.1..282.8 in city world metres).

name: Cupid's Span
note: Rincon Park, giant bow and part-buried arrow (Oldenburg/van Bruggen 2002). POSITION CORRECTED 2026-10-03: was 37.791/-122.3899, 60 m south in the Embarcadero roadway (owner: 'in the middle of the road'); now the centre of way/175010375, the sculpture's own outline in OSM.

name: Ruth Asawa Mermaid Fountain
note: Ghirardelli Square: basin only, figures coming from the owner. Round stepped basin and a central plinth for the hand-modelled mermaid group.

name: Redwood Park pool
note: Transamerica Redwood Park: basin only, figures coming from the owner. Small granite-rimmed pool and nearby puddle discs for the hand-modelled frog and Puddle Jumpers children.

name: MLK Memorial Waterfall
note: Yerba Buena Gardens, cut into the level change. Position CORRECTED from 37.7853/-122.4029 (103 m out, in the north-west corner of the park where there is nothing) to the centre of OSM way/25298444, amenity=fountain natural=water, which is the memorial's own water. The pier wall follows way/684190996; the pools are way/1167668187 and way/1326136219. Built in landmarks/sf/yerba-buena.ts with the rest of the block.

name: Language of the Birds
note: Broadway and Columbus, translucent books suspended on poles over the pavement.

name: Francis Scott Key Monument canopy
note: Golden Gate Park: the stone canopy only — the figure is a real model placed separately.

name: Robert Louis Stevenson Memorial
note: Portsmouth Square, granite shaft with a small bronze galleon on top.
